verdict.rationale: Pulley documents an 83(b) Election status tracker and markets compliance software that covers 'ASC 718 reporting and tax filings,' so part of the story is first-party. Rule 701 disclosure thresholds and Form 3921 are never named, and nothing shows filings are generated automatically from the cap table. Missing for 10: Rule 701 threshold tracking, explicit Form 3921 generation and filing, evidence that filings are generated automatically from cap table data, in-depth docs on the 83(b) tracker, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, US equity compliance — Rule 701 disclosure thresholds, Form 3921 filings, 83(b) elections — is tracked and generated from the cap table automatically

citations.quote: Pulley's equity compliance software handles the compliance work your finance team owns as you grow, from ASC 718 reporting and tax filings to board management.
